g.aria-label: Title text 'Trailing temperature windows lower the daily lag-free network's CRPS in every band; it still trails the lag-enabled A-pool at 0 to 120 h at the eight. CRPS in points of capacity; smaller is better. Five folds, two seeds, no labelled event.'

text.tspan: Trailing temperature windows lower the daily lag-free network's CRPS in every band;
it still trails the lag-enabled A-pool at 0 to 120 h at the eight.
CRPS in points of capacity; smaller is better. Five folds, two seeds, no labelled event.
